additional_info.body:
Hello Nicolas, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I checked this charging session and everything looks ok:
As you can see, the EV is slowly ramping down the current, according to the SoC. The Maximum power in the first photo is 140kW and we are only supplying ~70kW.
Please let me know if this answered to your question and I can close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0447145-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2/P0 312561850/18] load distribution parameter Issue CRM:02698000487
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
I hope you are doing well too.
Thank you for your reply.
I'm not sure I understand correctly.
On site, when someone charges on one of the two charging points, the second one becomes “unavailable.” It is then impossible to select the other charging point.
I was able to test this with a colleague who was on site. This happens even with low power ratings.
Does your reply explain this behavior ? I don’t get it
☹
Yesterday in the afternoon, I discussed this with the regional team, and they told me that it could be related to one or more faulty contactors that allow power to be distributed between the two connectors. This is the diagnosis that was made on another of our chargers a few weeks ago (according to the regional team).
Thanks.
Best regards,
Nicolas RAYMOND

additional_info.subject: ID0447145-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2/P0 312561850/18] load distribution parameter Issue CRM:02698000487
additional_info.body:
Hello Nicolas,
Thank you for your fast feedback.
I missunderstood the topic of the ticket.
The reason why the DC1 is out of order is because there is a communication drop between our PLC and the SECC. We have a fix for this in v8.0.5 by default.
If you do not agree to install a new version, I can install a hotfix, for the moment, which mitigates the issue completely from software side.
If the error persists after the hotfix/update, then we need to send the Field service technicians to troubleshoot it further.
I apologise again for my misinterpretation, I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
